exposure: age at the time of operation
cohort: 207 eyes of 160 patients who underwent surgery for congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction (CNLDO)
finding: The rate of silicone tube implantation was significantly higher in vaginal deliveries compared to cesarean sections, suggesting a persistent structural obstruction despite high intrauterine pressure and enzymatic lysis in vaginal births.
mod_finding: The rate of silicone tube implantation was significantly higher in vaginal deliveries compared to cesarean sections.
